content: Sonos is rolling out a big app update that includes new Presets and early access to its AI voice assistant. You can create a preset to play music at a specific volume in a certain room, which will appear directly on the homescreen so you can quickly start playback. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/presets-sonos.webp?quality=90&strip=all] If you’re in the US, you can also sign up for a spot on the waitlist for the new Sonos 27voice assistant on November 6th, with access starting on November 12th. As teased by Sonos previously, you’ll be able to use the assistant to do things like start music, move playback to another room, group and ungroup speakers, and set timers. But Sonos says it can also complete more complicated requests using natural language, such as “Play the album with a sardine tin on the cover,” or “Who was the singer at the superbowl? Play their latest album on Hallway.” These updates are part of efforts to recover from a disastrous app redesign in 2024, which Sonos CEO Tom Conrad has promised to reverse. The company launched a revamped Sonos 27 app operating system update in September with the ability to connect AI agents to the app. Sonos plans to allow users to create up to 10 custom agents as well. Other features coming to the Sonos app in this update include the ability to swipe on the “Now Playing” screen or mini player to skip tracks, and a way to rearrange your favorites. The Sonos app can also work with the iOS-only System Health feature, which can help you spot problems in your setup.

chineseContent: Sonos 正在推出一项大型应用程序更新，其中包括新的预设以及对其 AI 语音助手的抢先体验。您可以创建预设以在某个房间以特定音量播放音乐，该预设将直接显示在主屏幕上，以便您可以快速开始播放。 [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/presets-sonos.webp?quality=90&strip=all] 如果您在美国，您还可以在 11 月 6 日注册新 Sonos 27voice 助手的候补名单，并从 11 月 12 日开始访问。正如 Sonos 之前所说，您将能够使用助手执行一些操作，例如开始音乐、将播放移动到另一个房间、对扬声器进行分组和取消分组以及设置计时器。但 Sonos 表示，它还可以使用自然语言完成更复杂的请求，例如“播放封面上有沙丁鱼罐头的专辑”或“超级碗上的歌手是谁？在走廊上播放他们的最新专辑”。这些更新是从 2024 年灾难性的应用程序重新设计中恢复过来的努力的一部分，Sonos 首席执行官汤姆·康拉德 (Tom Conrad) 承诺扭转这一局面。该公司于 9 月份推出了经过改进的 Sonos 27 应用程序操作系统更新，能够将人工智能代理连接到该应用程序。 Sonos 还计划允许用户创建最多 10 个自定义代理。此次更新中 Sonos 应用程序的其他功能包括在“正在播放”屏幕或迷你播放器上滑动以跳过曲目的功能，以及重新排列您的最爱的方式。 Sonos 应用程序还可以与仅限 iOS 的系统健康功能配合使用，该功能可以帮助您发现设置中的问题。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
